Subject: Your breach of contract matter (Project Harrier)

Dear Mr. Karve,

Thank you for meeting us on 27 May 2020 about your dispute with Desai Motors Ltd. As we understand it, the counterparty has not paid the invoices for delivered goods. The matter is listed before the Nagpur Commercial Court.

Our advice is to invoke the arbitration clause and seek interim relief to secure the amount. Please collect the contract, the invoices and the delivery challans and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs. 11,39,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
